BEFORE TIME ITSELF...
There was an infinite weave of intersections —
the Great Goban. A cosmos of pure order
where vital energy, the Qi, flowed endlessly.
Then came The Void.
It fractured everything. The cosmos split into floating islands,
disconnected and dying.
You are the Cosmic Weaver.
Only you can sew the cracks.
